title: Дети Атома — деление, ветвление, ядерные события и UAP: межреестровый аудит
user_intent: Сопоставить доктрину Children of Atom о делении атома и создании новых вселенных с современными интерпретациями квантовой механики, существующими JANUS UAP/nuclear registries и наблюдаемыми долговременными следами ядерных событий.

primary_registry_roots.role: существующий ядерный simulation registry; содержит модель переходов neutron/stable/unstable/fragment и связь с UAP hypothesis
существующий Bayesian nuclear-attraction/UAP registry с разделением correlation/interference hypotheses
существующий preregistered CONUS spatial registry: official nuclear sites + UAP incidents
historical atomic-registry root recovered through repository history; exact file was later deleted from main, so provenance is historical rather than current-main

repository_history.evidence: Repository history contains deletion commits for the HAWKAR_INDIVISIBLE_CHILDREN... artifact; the historical presence is confirmed, but current-main availability is false.

fallout_canon.children_of_atom_claim: Each atomic mass contains a universe; splitting an atomic mass splits the universe; sufficiently large atomic destruction creates enormous numbers of new universes; the Great War is treated by Cromwell as the latest such event.
fallout_canon.interpretive_value: The Fallout doctrine supplies a narrative model in which nuclear division is not only destruction but generative cosmology: division becomes multiplicity.
fallout_canon.nonclaim: This does not establish that Fallout's cosmology describes real quantum mechanics.

many_worlds_interpretation.core: The universal quantum state evolves without fundamental collapse; decoherence produces effectively autonomous quasi-classical branch structures. In the MWI literature, worlds are emergent descriptions of decohered sectors rather than little classical universes being manufactured by a mechanical explosion.
many_worlds_interpretation.current_source: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Summer 2026 revision
many_worlds_interpretation.source_claim: MWI describes many parallel worlds in the same space and time; decoherence is central to the emergence of stable branching structures.

decoherence.role: environmental entanglement suppresses interference between macroscopically distinct sectors and makes classical records stable enough for observers
decoherence.important_correction: Decoherence is not a literal explosion of a wavefunction into spatially separated classical universes; it is a dynamical quantum process involving entanglement with environmental degrees of freedom.
decoherence.citation_note: Decoherence is described as the bridge between quantum and classical descriptions and as a mechanism for identifying stable branching structures. citeturn104714search5turn104714search4

branch_count.reason: The number of branches depends on coarse-graining/decomposition and is not equivalent to counting atoms or fission fragments one-for-one.
branch_count.nonclaim: One fission event does not have a scientifically established mapping of exactly one new universe per fragment.

fission_specific_observation.statement: Nuclear fission is a quantum process; fission fragments can be entangled and acquire angular momentum. Recent 2026 work explicitly studies entanglement generated in fission fragments.
fission_specific_observation.citation_note: 2026 PRL result: intrinsic angular momentum and entanglement generation in fission fragments. citeturn104714search8
fission_specific_observation.boundary: Fission entanglement is not evidence that separate macroscopic universes are generated in an experimentally accessible sense.

cosmology_scale_correction.statement: Human nuclear fission cannot be treated as a source of the material content from which future galaxies are created. Cosmic structure and elemental abundances are governed by early-universe physics, stellar nucleosynthesis and astrophysical processes on vastly different scales.
cosmology_scale_correction.nonclaim: Human nuclear weapons do not seed future galaxies in the ordinary astrophysical sense.

bridge_model.name: ATOMIC_DIVISION_TO_CLASSICAL_BRANCHING_RECORD

layers.description: Quantum interaction/fission changes the joint quantum state of system and environment.
Environmental entanglement/decoherence makes alternatives effectively dynamically autonomous for local observers.
Macroscopic amplification produces durable records: detector states, thermal damage, isotopic signatures, atmospheric changes and historical records.
In an Everettian reading, L1 can be described as branch formation; the classical history recorded at L2 is branch-relative.
Children of Atom reinterpret the entire chain as literal universe creation by atomic division.

bridge_model.key_rule: L0-L2 are physics; L3 is an interpretation; L4 is Fallout theology. Never merge the four layers into one empirical claim.

uap_cross_registry.coverage: CONUS 2000-2024; Layer_1 official nuclear sites; Layer_2 UAP incidents; Layer_3 preregistered statistics; Layer_4 speculation isolated.
uap_cross_registry.source_integrity: The registry itself records source-scoped data and preregistered hypotheses; this artifact does not independently re-validate every underlying incident.
uap_cross_registry.citation_note: The registry identifies official nuclear-site nodes including Nevada Test Site, Los Alamos, Sandia, Oak Ridge, Hanford, Savannah River, Pantex and ICBM bases. fileciteturn572file9L188-L188

prior_analytic_registry.structure: five hypotheses: conventional military, black projects, misidentification, nuclear attraction, other factors; sensitivity analysis and Monte Carlo were preregistered in that artifact.
prior_analytic_registry.important_boundary: Existing posterior numbers are inherited historical registry outputs, not re-run in this artifact and not independently upgraded to present-day truth.

uap_nuclear_test_design.question: Does the spatial/temporal concentration of UAP reports around nuclear infrastructure carry information beyond exposure created by military activity, surveillance density, population, air traffic, publicity and reporting bias?
required_controls: distance to multiple nuclear-site classes rather than one pooled class
uap_nuclear_test_design.preferred_design: matched case-control or point-process model with preregistered buffers and temporal windows
uap_nuclear_test_design.negative_control: Use non-nuclear military installations with comparable air traffic/sensor density to test whether any apparent nuclear effect is actually military-observation density.
uap_nuclear_test_design.interpretation_ceiling: Even a statistically significant association would establish correlation, not extraterrestrial causation, branch creation or observer influence.

explosion_and_aftermath_layer.reference: IAEA bomb-peak AMS material records atmospheric radiocarbon perturbation from nuclear testing; this is an example of a durable global environmental record of nuclear activity. citeturn104714search2
explosion_and_aftermath_layer.important_distinction: Persistent post-event records show that an atomic event can imprint the world for decades or longer; they do not imply the event created a new universe.

H0.name: Single-universe conventional physics
H0.claim: Fission changes matter/radiation fields and environmental records within one physical universe.

H1.name: Everettian branch amplification
H1.claim: Fission and its environmental entanglement contribute to branching structure in an Everettian description.
H1.support: Consistent with MWI/decoherence framework; not uniquely tested by fission alone. citeturn104714search1turn104714search5turn104714search8

H2.name: Atomic mass literally contains a classical universe
H2.claim: Children of Atom doctrine: one atomic mass literally contains a universe.

H3.name: UAP preferentially respond to nuclear sites/events
H3.claim: The UAP registry's nuclear-attraction hypothesis predicts spatial/temporal enrichment near nuclear nodes.

H4.name: Nuclear events create detectable branch-dependent effects observable by UAP
H4.claim: A stronger causal chain: nuclear event -> branch-relevant phenomenon -> UAP detectability.

cross_registry_parallel.janus_synthesis: The strongest defensible bridge is not 'fission creates galaxies' but 'microscopic quantum alternatives can be amplified into persistent macroscopic histories; an Everettian reading calls the resulting decohered structure branching.'

test_suite.T1_literature_boundary_test: Verify that current quantum foundations distinguish branching/decoherence from literal particle-counted universe creation.
test_suite.T2_fission_entanglement_test: Track fission literature for entanglement/decoherence signatures without converting them into cosmological claims.
test_suite.T3_uap_nuclear_spatial_test: Re-run the CONUS registry with exposure controls and matched military controls.
test_suite.T4_event_window_test: Compare UAP report rates around documented nuclear-event days against matched control days.
test_suite.T5_environmental_record_test: Use radionuclide/radiocarbon timelines as physical aftermath covariates, not as branch detectors.
test_suite.T6_false_bridge_test: Attempt to explain every observed UAP/nuclear association using non-extraterrestrial controls before admitting H3/H4.
test_suite.T7_branch_claim_ceiling: No empirical result upgrades H1 into 'new classical universes observed' without a unique observable prediction that distinguishes MWI from competing interpretations.

final_assessment.current_best_bridge: QUANTUM_EVENT -> ENTANGLEMENT/DECOHERENCE -> MACROSCOPIC RECORDS; IN EVERETTIAN LANGUAGE, BRANCH STRUCTURE IS AN INTERPRETIVE DESCRIPTION.
